title: BioConnect
address: 6420 Levit Green Boulevard, Houston, Texas, 77021, United States
description: We invite all healthcare technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and biotech stakeholders to join us for the BioConnect networking series (the 1st Tuesday of each month).  BioConnect promotes collaboration among academic and industry innovators and key stakeholders within our growing biotech ecosystem. This month, BioConnect is hosted by Levit Green.  All career levels (e.g., students and postdocs) are welcome. Register at biohouston.org/events

title: GHP Bayou City Bio Pulse
address: 909 Fannin Street, Unit 200, Houston, Texas, 77010, United States
description:
Life Sciences Ecosystem Expo & Future Forum

Join the Greater Houston Partnership and BioHouston for the next Bayou City Bio Pulse, hosted by Gensler. This expo-style program will bring together organizations, companies, and service providers that support and enable growth across Houston’s biotech, medtech, and health innovation ecosystem.

The program will include opportunities to connect directly with ecosystem partners, learn about available resources for entrepreneurs and potential founders, and hear from accelerators and entrepreneurship programs through a featured reverse pitch session. The event will also include open networking, expo engagement, and breakout discussions designed to support connection across the region’s life sciences community.

title: Accelerator for Cancer Therapeutics (ACT) Information Session
description: Interested in taking your cancer research to the next level? Join us to learn how to become a part of the next cohort of the Accelerator for Cancer Therapeutics (ACT), a CPRIT-funded program that helps academic investigators and entrepreneurs navigate the commercialization milestones between breakthrough science and a successful biotech company.

title: 12th Annual WISE Luncheon
description: The Women in Science with Excellence (WISE) Luncheon honors exceptional women whose work is shaping Houston’s future across science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. From groundbreaking research and clinical innovation to energy, education, entrepreneurship, and industry leadership, WISE recognizes women whose achievements have made a lasting impact on their fields and on our region. Now in its 12th year, the luncheon brings together leaders from across Houston’s innovation ecosystem to celebrate excellence, hear inspiring stories, and recognize the women helping move discovery, business, and community forward.

title: 15th Annual Texas Life Science Forum
address: 1900 Rice Blvd, Houston, TX 77005, United States
description: The Texas Life Science Forum (TLSF) returns for its 15th year as Texas’ premier life science and healthtech conference, bringing together emerging biotech, medtech, diagnostics, digital health companies, investors, academic leaders, and industry stakeholders from across the region and beyond. Co-hosted by BioHouston and the Rice Alliance, the forum features company pitches, investor engagement, networking opportunities, and thought-provoking panels focused on advancing healthcare innovation and commercialization. Join the life science community on November 10–11, 2026, at Rice University’s McNair Hall to connect with innovators shaping the future of healthcare. Learn more and register at Texas Life Science Forum.
